newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's Koebnick says no need to raise rates now.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Koebnick says no need to raise rates now.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Hans-Juergen Koebnick said on Tuesday there was no reason to raise German interest rates at present, according to a spokesman who confirmed comments made in an interview with a news agency.

Asked whether there was a reason for the Bundesbank to raise interest rates to support the mark, Koebnick said there was no reason to have higher interest rates, said the spokesman for the state central bank of Rhineland-Palatinate and Saarland.
Asked whether he viewed the mark as a strong currency, Koebnick said, "Of course it is," the spokesman said.
Koebnick is president of the state central bank.
